dimension_resolution.method: scan info_type/info varlen, read info_type/id.bin at matching row
scan kind_type/kind varlen (7 rows), collect ids
scan link_type/link varlen (18 rows), set mask[id]=1 for matches

scan company_name/country_code varlen once; mask[r] = (slice != '[us]' AND slice non-empty? include NULLs per SQL semantics: treat NULL as not equal, i.e., include). Standard IMDB-JOB practice: include only rows where country_code present and != '[us]'.

join_order.notes: Drive on movie_link rather than title; ml is small (30k) and link_type filter is highly selective (~3/18). Each surviving ml row gives both t1.id (ml.movie_id) and t2.id (ml.linked_movie_id) directly.
Look up title row via title__id__pos[t1_id]; check kind_id in kt_allowed_ids (linear scan over 2 ids).

join_order.probe: title row for t2_id via title__id__pos
join_order.notes: title__id__pos[t2_id] -> row r2; check production_year_bin[r2] in [2000,2010] (skip if -1 NULL) AND kind_id[r2] in kt_allowed_ids.

join_order.probe: movie_info_idx via primary CSR on movie_id (range [off[t1_id], off[t1_id+1]))
join_order.notes: For each row in range, require info_type_id == it_rating_id. Track min(info) lexicographic across matching rows. At least one match required (semi).

join_order.probe: movie_companies via primary CSR on movie_id (range [off[t1_id], off[t1_id+1]))
join_order.notes: For each mc1 row in range, look up company_id; pos = company_name__id__pos[company_id]; require pos>=0 AND cn_ok_mask[pos]. Track min(company_name.name).

join_order.probe: movie_info_idx via primary CSR on movie_id (range for t2_id)
join_order.notes: Range scan; require info_type_id == it_rating_id AND info < '3.5' (lex). Track min(info).

join_order.build: company_name__id__pos (any company allowed; no country_code filter on cn2)
join_order.probe: movie_companies via primary CSR on movie_id (range for t2_id)
join_order.notes: Any mc2 row qualifies; track min(company_name.name) across matching companies. Must exist at least once.

parallelism.notes: Partition the (filtered) ml row index space across 12 threads. Each thread maintains thread-local min accumulators (string copies); reduce at end with lex-min.

indexes.purpose: not used as probe — ml driven via full scan; provides physical layout only
OPTIONAL alternative driver — skip; full scan of 30k ml with bitset is simpler and similar cost
map t1_id and t2_id to title row positions for kind_id/production_year/title lookups
range probe for mi_idx1 (by t1_id) and mi_idx2 (by t2_id)
range probe for mc1 (by t1_id) and mc2 (by t2_id)
map mc.company_id -> company_name row for country_code mask test and name projection
not strictly needed — only the resolved it_rating_id is used for FK equality
not used — lt_allowed_mask built directly on id values
not used — kt_allowed_ids checked as small set against title.kind_id

projection_handling.min_t1_title: read title/title.{offsets,data}.bin at pos=title__id__pos[t1_id] when row passes all checks
projection_handling.min_mi_idx1_info: track min over matching mi_idx1 rows during range scan
projection_handling.min_mi_idx2_info: track min over matching mi_idx2 rows during range scan
projection_handling.min_cn1_name: track min over matching mc1->cn1 company_name rows
projection_handling.min_cn2_name: track min over matching mc2->cn2 company_name rows
projection_handling.early_exit: NOT safe — MIN aggregation requires full materialization of survivors
